Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Inner join compound_structures to enforce presence of SMILES. Filter by target name, standard type IC50, and presence of PubMed ID or DOI. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism.
